How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's how to set it up and what to expect:
Unboxing (First 30 Days)
Open your mattress within 30 days of delivery to ensure it expands properly and your warranty remains valid. Unbox it in the room where you'll use it to minimize handling.
Open the box and slide the mattress out
Remove the outer wrap, but don't cut the inner plastic yet
Place it on your bed frame or foundation
Cut the inner vacuum seal — it'll start expanding immediately (fun to watch!)
Expansion Timeline
Within 30 minutes: Ready to sleep on
Within 3-5 hours: Full expansion (lift corners and give it a gentle shake to help)
Within a few days: Wrinkles smooth out naturally
The Break-In Period (Most Important!)
The wool and cotton layers will soften and compress naturally over the first 30-60 days. The mattress you sleep on tonight won't feel the same in six weeks — this is normal for organic materials. Your Eco Organic has a 100-night sleep trial with a 30-day minimum before returns, because most people who wait are glad they did.
You might experience some adjustment aches as your body adapts to proper support — this can take a month or more, but it's worth it.
